r13_contract.comparisonModel: where k is the shape parameter of the spectrum, Nice is the number of load cycles in the spectrum, and Fice is the random variable for ice loads on the blade, 0 <= Fice <= (Fice)max. The shape parameter k=0.75 shall be used for the ice force distribution of an open propeller and the shape parameter k=1.0 for that of a ducted propeller blade.
